title: fix(plugin-approvals): label the approval request's record_id "Record", since the column shows the record and not its id
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWhH54PfJ4zCeekSwbSNYhf)_

Fixes #28250

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：审批请求（sys_approval_request）的 `record_id` 字段显示名由 “Record ID” 改为 “Record”；中文 “记录”、日文 “レコード”、西班牙文 “Registro” 同步改。
- 为什么改：Setup › 审批请求列表里这一列显示的是目标记录的图标和名称，不是 ID；表头写 “Record ID” 让管理员去找一个并不存在的 ID（HotCRM 客户走查 S9 发现）。
- 风险与回滚：只改显示名；字段名 `record_id`、查询、种子数据、与 `object_name` 的指针对、记录锁都不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts（record_id 的 label）、packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts（sys_approval_request.fields.record_id）。
- 两分钟验证：在 Console 打开 Setup › 审批请求，四个列表视图的表头、请求详情页的亮点条与 Details 标签都显示 “Record”（中文界面显示 “记录”）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The Approval Requests list views draw the `record_id` cell as the target record (its object's icon and name), because `record_id` is the id half of the request's pointer pair with `object_name` (ADR-0052 §5). The header "Record ID" therefore disagreed with the cell.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts`: `record_id` label `'Record ID'` becomes `'Record'`. Nothing else in the field moves.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/translations/en.objects.generated.ts`: regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`; the only diff across all nine bundle packages is this one leaf.
- zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES hand values: 记录 ID → 记录, レコード ID → レコード, ID de registro → Registro. These are the words the same plugin already uses for `sys_approval_action.record_id` ("Record"), so the two approval objects now agree. The leaf has no source-hash entry in any locale, so no hash table moves.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` patch.

## Tests

No test pinned the old label (`git grep` for each of the four old strings outside the bundles: 0 hits in tests, 0 under `ui/`), and a label is display copy no consumer parses, so no new pin is added. The pointer-pair, query and seed tests are untouched and pass unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- `object_name` keeps its label "Object". It is not a list column (no list view shows a pointer's type half), and on the Details tab "Object" beside "Record" reads correctly, so it is not the same defect.
- `origin/main` moved after branch-off; `git merge-tree` against it is clean and none of the incoming files are this PR's.
- Same pattern elsewhere, carried by the seat as its own `domain:server` card: `sys_audit_log` and `sys_activity` (plugin-audit) also declare `record_id` with `referenceVia` and keep "Record ID". `sys_mail_association.record_id` (service-mailbox) is a different case: its record page shows it only in the highlights strip, which draws the stored id, so its label is right until that strip leaves it out.
